description: This file defines the ListViewMerge class used for merging list view metadata in the SuiteCRM/SugarCRM framework. It extends the EditViewMerge class and manages the merging process of list view definitions, panels, and fields during module upgrades or customizations.

classes.name: ListViewMerge
classes.description: A class for merging list view metadata during module upgrade or customization, transforming list view definitions into editable formats and merging field definitions while preserving order and Source.

methods.name: loadData
methods.description: Loads metadata from original, new, and custom files and transforms them into a structure suitable for merging.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Extracts fields from panels into an associative array with metadata and location.

methods.name: buildPanels
methods.description: Constructs panels from merged fields, maintaining order and source priority.

methods.name: setPanels
methods.description: Sets newData property with built panels from merged fields.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves merged list view metadata to a specified file.

methods.name: mergeFields
methods.description: Merges individual fields' metadata across original, new, and custom sources.

methods.name: mergeField
methods.description: Merges metadata for a single field, handling conflicts and preferences.
